    Lemma B.2: the derivative cokernels over ℤ/4 are killed by two #

    lem:integral-mesh-cokernels (characteristic-two-mesh-calculations.tex): "Each retained derivative cokernel is thus killed by two. … All other degree and weight components vanish by their zero reduction."

    With 𝒪 = ℤ/4 and unit coefficients ũ reducing to the coefficients c of a scalar mesh category over 𝔽₂: given rows spanning the cokernels over 𝔽₂ (CokerSpan; for C⁽²⁾ these are IndSkeleton.prime_cokerSpan) which are killed by two over every coefficient ring (TwoRows, from the trace calculations), and since reduction is right exact (ReductionMesh), every family of degree m + 1 ≥ 3 is, up to 2·(families), an 𝒪-combination of these rows plus a derivative, so twice it is a derivative (two_smul_mem_imageD).
